info.name: publicrecords Apify Actors (Etsy, sports odds, jobs, government data)
info.description: Call the publicrecords Actors on Apify with your own Apify API token. Set the collection variable apifyToken (keep it as a secret / current value only; never commit it).

item.name: Etsy Scraper — Listings, Prices & Best Sellers
item.description:
Scrape Etsy search results by keyword, category or market page: title, price, rating, reviews, Bestseller and Star Seller badges, ad flag and search rank.

Store page: https://apify.com/publicrecords/etsy-search-scraper

request.description: Waits up to 300 s, returns items.

item.name: Etsy Shop Sales Tracker & Scraper
item.description:
Track Etsy shop sales counters with this Etsy shop scraper: measured sales counts with the date each was read. One row per shop, pay per shop.

Store page: https://apify.com/publicrecords/etsy-shop-velocity

request.description: Waits up to 300 s, returns items.

item.name: Legistar City Council Minutes & Agendas: meetings, items
item.description:
What did a city council decide? Returns Legistar meetings, agenda items, votes and documents for any city on Legistar, with the source link.

Store page: https://apify.com/publicrecords/legistar-meetings-scraper

request.description: Waits up to 300 s, returns items.

item.name: Company Website to LinkedIn & Social Media Links
item.description:
Which social profiles belong to this company? Resolves a name, website or Google Maps listing to its LinkedIn, X, YouTube, Instagram and Facebook handles, with evidence. Instagram and Facebook are returned from the site on the default path, not platform-verified.

Store page: https://apify.com/publicrecords/company-social-profile-finder

request.description: Waits up to 300 s, returns items.

item.name: Sports Odds API: BetRivers, Unibet, Paf, Svenska Spel, ATG
item.description:
Live odds from 24 Kambi-powered sportsbooks in one call: BetRivers (12 US states + Ontario), Unibet (7 countries), Paf, Svenska Spel and ATG. One row per game with every book's price and the best price per outcome.

Store page: https://apify.com/publicrecords/sports-odds-api

request.description: Waits up to 300 s, returns items.

item.name: TED Tenders Daily: EU procurement notices from Tenders
item.description:
Which EU tenders were published today? Returns TED (Tenders Electronic Daily) notices with buyer, CPV, value, deadline and source link.

Store page: https://apify.com/publicrecords/eu-ted-notices-scraper

request.description: Waits up to 300 s, returns items.

item.name: SmartRecruiters Jobs Scraper — New Postings Since Any Date

request.description: Waits up to 300 s, returns items.

request.description: Waits up to 300 s, returns items.

item.name: USAspending API Awards: federal contract and grant awards
item.description:
Who won federal contracts and grants, and for how much? Pulls USAspending awards by agency, recipient, NAICS and period, with award IDs and source links.

Store page: https://apify.com/publicrecords/usaspending-awards-scraper

request.description: Waits up to 300 s, returns items.

item.name: Calibration Ledger — trust a forecast, with evidence (beta)
item.description:
Given a claim from an organization (IMF, OECD, Fed/FOMC, SPF, ECB SPF, or a listed issuer), returns that organization's track record: error distribution, intervals, bias, band coverage, worst misses with source links — or honest 'no coverage' (free). Organizations only, never people.

Store page: https://apify.com/publicrecords/calibration-ledger

request.description: Waits up to 300 s, returns items.
